name: SKYECHIP
recent: SkyeChip 在 2026 年 10 月 30 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，营收 5,415.7 万令吉，净利 1,770.6 万令吉。公司近期有多项董事持股变动公告，独立非执行主席 Dato' Seri Wong Siew Hai 在公开市场及闭门期内外均有交易。此外，公司因行使 ESOS 期权而发行新股，并已举行股东大会。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，营收 5,415.7 万令吉，净利 1,770.6 万令吉。
因行使 ESOS 期权而发行 2,000 股新股，发行价每股 0.88 令吉，于 2026 年 10 月 7 日上市。
独立非执行主席 Dato' Seri Wong Siew Hai 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月期间多次增持公司股份。
risks: 董事在闭门期内进行交易，并已提呈交易意向通知。
公司因 ESOS 期权行使而发行新股，可能对每股盈利造成轻微摊薄。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度，营收为 5,415.7 万令吉，环比增长 9.1%；净利为 1,770.6 万令吉，环比增长 27.2%；净利率为 32.7%，高于上一季度的 28.0%。

recent_en: SkyeChip announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 30 October 2026, with revenue of RM54.157 million and net profit of RM17.706 million. The company has also made several announcements on changes in director's interest, with Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dato' Seri Wong Siew Hai transacting shares both in the open market and during closed periods. In addition, the company issued new shares upon exercise of ESOS options and held its general meeting.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue of RM54.157 million and net profit of RM17.706 million.
Issued 2,000 new shares upon exercise of ESOS options at an issue price of RM0.88 per share, listed on 7 October 2026.
Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dato' Seri Wong Siew Hai acquired shares in the company multiple times between September and November 2026.
risks_en: Directors traded during the closed period and had submitted notifications of intention to deal.
The company issued new shares upon exercise of ESOS options, which may cause slight dilution to earnings per share.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM54.157 million, up 9.1% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM17.706 million, up 27.2% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 32.7%, higher than 28.0% in the previous quarter.
